name: Combobox
summary: Searchable single-choice dropdown. Field-shell trigger + portaled listbox filtered by the typed query. Use when Select's static list would exceed ~12 options. v0.12.4 — listbox renders via createPortal(<div fixed>, document.body) with getBoundingClientRect tracking on scroll (capture phase) + resize, escaping every ancestor's overflow context (Showcase frames, <Card padding='none'>, glass surfaces, scroll containers).

onChange.description: Fires when an option is picked.

options.description: Array of option strings (or { label, value } pairs in extended consumers).

name.description: Form field name when used inside a Form.

maxVisible.description: Cap the visible rows; scroll past this.

keyboard: Type — filter the list and open it
Home / End — first / last visible match
rules: role=combobox on the input; aria-expanded, aria-autocomplete=list, aria-controls all wired.

Listbox portals to <body> via createPortal(<div fixed>, document.body) with getBoundingClientRect tracking (v0.12.4) so it escapes overflow:hidden ancestors (dialogs, tables, Showcase frames, <Card padding='none'>, glass surfaces, scroll containers).
Highlighted row carries aria-selected=true for screen-reader announcement.
Always paired with a visible label via Field, or with aria-label.
Outside-click dismiss exempts the portaled list (clicks on options must reach the option handler, not trigger close-before-select).

do: Use Combobox for searchable / dynamic / large option lists.
Cap visible rows at 8 with internal scroll past that.
Render the listbox via createPortal(<div fixed>, document.body) with getBoundingClientRect tracking on scroll (capture phase) + resize (v0.12.4 contract).
Exempt the portaled list from the outside-click dismiss handler — option clicks must reach the handler, not close-before-select.
dont: Don't use Combobox for short stable lists — Select is denser and faster to scan.
Don't auto-select on blur unless the typed value is an exact match.
Don't disable Enter when no option matches — let the user submit and surface a 'no matches' hint.

Don't render the dropdown as an inline <div absolute> anchored to the trigger's relative wrapper — Tailwind absolute resolves against the nearest relative ancestor's painting box, which is clipped by ancestor overflow:hidden. Use the portal pattern.

Don't anchor the portaled list with position:absolute — position:fixed is what makes the coordinates viewport-relative (matches getBoundingClientRect output). position:absolute would re-introduce the ancestor-context dependency that the portal was designed to escape.

changelog.note: Dropdown listbox migrates from inline <div absolute> (anchored to the trigger's relative wrapper) to createPortal(<div style={{ position: 'fixed', top, left, width, zIndex }} />, document.body). Position re-tracked on scroll (capture phase) + resize via getBoundingClientRect. Outside-click dismiss exempts the portaled list (so option clicks don't close-before-select). Closes the user-reported /library Showcase-frame clipping bug + structurally protects the Combobox inside <Card padding='none'>, glass surfaces, scroll containers, and any nested overflow-clipped ancestor. Same pattern Radix Popover / Tooltip / DropdownMenu use throughout the rest of the system; v0.12.4 brought the hand-rolled Combobox in line. No new ADR — the pattern is exactly the floating-UI portal contract the rest of the system already follows. See CHANGELOG v0.12.4 entry.
Initial release. Promotes the v0.6 audit-dashboard primitive in inputs.tsx to a dedicated contract. Reuses select.listbox.* tokens; adds combobox-only deltas (caret rotation, item highlight states).
